house_style: Soft painterly landscape illustration for a high school resources game: early morning light, deep lake blues, forest greens and warm roof colors, calm and peaceful, deserted. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: The town background at year 0, shown under a scrim with live overlays drawn on top (forest loss, mud, boats, homes), so the lake and slopes stay open and readable.

assets.name: lake-town
assets.prompt: A calm lake town seen from a low hill at a slant: forested green hills around a wide blue lake, a few small wooden docks on the near shore, a cluster of small houses with brown and gray roofs, a river mouth entering the lake through a green floodplain meadow, early morning light, still water, empty and quiet.
